Docs.summary: Provides a bounded, least-recently-used cache of Graphite texture-backed images keyed by source image.

remarks.para: Use the cache to avoid repeatedly uploading the same image to the GPU each frame. Pass as the find-or-create callback when creating a recorder, and dispose the cache while its recorder is still alive.
